A letter, for you

Irdyna, honestly i tak tahu macam mana nak explain everything i feel for you, but one thing i know is that you mean more to me than you probably realise.

Sometimes i terfikir balik about our first late night drive and when we went to Night of Fright. I don’t know if you remember those moments the same way i do, but for me, they were genuinely special. It’s not even about where we went or what we did, but more about the fact that i got to spend that time with you. Somehow, benda simple macam tu pun boleh jadi something yang i simpan dalam ingatan sampai sekarang. And if you ask me, i would love to have more moments like that with you.

I suka being around you, Irdyna. I suka bila we can talk about random things, bila we laugh over something stupid, and even bila we don’t really have anything special to talk about. There’s just something about you that makes ordinary moments feel a little different. I can’t really explain it, but being able to spend time with you is something i genuinely appreciate. You don’t have to do anything extraordinary to make me happy. Sometimes, just having you around is already enough.

I know before this, you told me that you wanted us to be friends, and i still remember that. I respect how you feel, and i never want you to think that all the things i do for you come with an expectation. But if i’m being honest, my feelings for you never really stayed within the boundaries of friendship. The more i got to know you, the more i found myself wanting to be someone special in your life. Someone you can look forward to talking to, someone you feel comfortable sharing your days with, and someone who makes you feel appreciated even on the days when you don’t feel like yourself.

And Irdyna, i hope you know that you don’t always have to be okay around me. You don’t have to be happy all the time, you don’t have to pretend that everything is fine, and you don’t have to find the right words to explain what you’re feeling. If one day you feel tired of everything, i hope you know that you can talk to me without worrying about being a burden. I may not always know the perfect thing to say, but i’ll always try my best to understand you. Your feelings matter, your thoughts matter, and even the little things that you think nobody notices are worth listening to.

I want you to know that there’s so much about you worth appreciating. Not just the happy side of you, not just the version of you that smiles and makes everyone around you feel good, but also the side of you that gets tired, overthinks things, feels lost sometimes, or has days where you don’t feel like you’re enough. You don’t have to prove your worth to me by constantly being strong or by doing things to make people happy. You’re still someone worth caring for, even on the days when you don’t have much to give.

I know there are things about you that i haven’t discovered yet, and there are probably parts of your life that i still don’t fully understand. But i would love the chance to learn them, slowly, at your own pace. I want to know the little things that make you happy, the things that keep you awake at night, the dreams you’re scared to tell people about, and the kind of future you secretly wish for yourself. I want to celebrate your little achievements with you, remind you to be proud of yourself when you forget, and be someone who genuinely looks forward to hearing about your day.

Irdyna, i can’t promise that i’ll always know how to make everything better, because i’m human too, and sometimes i might get things wrong. But i can promise that my intentions towards you are genuine. If you ever give me the chance, i want to show you that affection doesn’t always have to be something big. Sometimes it’s remembering the little things you tell me, asking if you’ve eaten, checking whether you’ve reached home safely, listening when you need someone, and making sure you never have to question whether you’re appreciated.

I don’t want you to choose me because you feel sorry for me, and i don’t want you to feel like you owe me anything just because of how i feel. I know there’s someone else who might want the same thing that i want, and i’m not here to compete with anyone or convince you that i’m better than somebody else. I just want to be honest about my feelings because you deserve honesty, and i don’t want to keep acting like you’re just another friend to me when, deep down, i know you’re not.

If you ask me what i hope for, honestly, i hope that one day you’ll let me get a little closer to you. I hope we get to make more memories together, have more late night conversations, go to more places, and experience those little moments that might not mean much to anyone else but mean everything to us. I hope one day, when something good happens to you, i’ll be one of the people you naturally want to tell. And when life gets difficult, i hope i’ll be someone you feel comfortable turning to, not because you have no one else, but because you genuinely want me there.

And if one day you do choose me, Irdyna, i hope it’s because you feel happy with me, safe with me, and appreciated for who you are. I hope you never feel like you have to become someone else just to be loved by me. I want to know the real you, even the parts you’re still learning to love about yourself. I want us to grow together, understand each other better, and create something that feels right for both of us. Something we don’t have to force, something we can both be proud of.

I don’t know what the future holds for us, and i know i can’t ask you to feel the same way just because i feel this strongly. But if there’s even a small chance that you might want to explore this with me someday, i hope you won’t be afraid to tell me. We don’t have to rush anything. We can take our time and let things happen naturally.

For now, i just want you to know this: Irdyna, you are someone i genuinely appreciate, someone i’m happy to have met, and someone i’d be grateful to know more deeply. I’m happy that our paths crossed, and regardless of where this goes, i’ll always be thankful for the moments we’ve shared.

But if life gives me the chance to make more memories with you, i would choose that chance in a heartbeat. Because honestly, it’s not just about liking you. It’s about wanting to know you, understand you, appreciate you, and hopefully one day make you feel the same warmth that you unknowingly bring into my life.

I like you, Irdyna. More than a friend, more than i’ve probably managed to show you, and in a way that makes me genuinely hope there’s something beautiful waiting for us. I don’t need you to give me an answer just because i’ve poured my heart out to you. I just hope you can feel how sincere i am when i say that, if you ever decide to give me a chance, i’ll be happy to get to know you all over again, one little moment at a time. 🤍

with all my heart ♡

one last thing… 🥺

Irdyna, would you accept me as your boyfriend?

Whatever your answer is, I will respect it. Just be honest with me.
